tweets: One of the major dangers of calling external contracts is that they can take over the control flow.
In the reentrancy attack, a malicious contract calls back into the calling contract before the first invocation finishes.
This may cause the different invocations of the function to interact in undesirable ways.
Make sure all internal state changes are performed before the call is executed.
Use a reentrancy lock (ie. OpenZeppelin's ReentrancyGuard).
